name: FA_RET_SRC_LINES_T
description: FA_RET_SRC_LINES_T contains information of the source lines from retirement transactions.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Retirement interface identifier.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Source line identifier.

columns.name: COST_RETIRED
columns.description: Amount retired from the source line. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Cannot exceed asset cost.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: request ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated. Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
